$comment: The achievement ladder, authored here rather than typed into the Play Console, so it is reviewable in a diff and the encoded ids can be generated instead of copied. Pushed by tools/pgs-achievements.py through the Play Games Services Publishing API; that script also writes Assets/Scripts/Game/Services/AchievementIds.g.cs from the console's own reply, so the ids in code always come from the console rather than a paste. The Level Up bar is a minimum of 10 with 40+ recommended and four reachable within an hour of play (Quest eligibility) — the five marked firstHour are those four plus a spare, in case play-testing pushes one of them past the hour. 'anchor' is the state this is decided from, and is documentation for the reader: the evaluation itself lives in Achievements.Reassert, and a test pins every id here to a branch there. Point values are multiples of 5, none above 200, and the total is kept under 1000 — the current doc says 2000 but older ones say 1000, and Google asks that headroom be left for achievements not yet written either way.

achievements.description: Bring your first load of gathered goods home to camp.
